newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania to ease hard currency controls - C. Bank. [CORRECTED 15:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Romania to ease hard currency controls - C. Bank. [CORRECTED 15:00 GMT]

text.p: Romania will ease stringent exchange controls imposed earlier this month, by excluding most state companies and oil firms from the measures, Central Bank governor Mugur Isarescu said in a telephone interview.
(Corrects to show state companies will be excluded from the controls, not excluded from the easing of controls.)

The decision will be formally announced later on Wednesday, said Isarescu. He stressed Romania will once more allow companies to retain their hard currency holdings and said there were will be no change to the full retention system.
The move appeared to be a response to Western alarm at the exchange controls, which had damaged credibility ahead of a drive to raise loans on the international market.
